verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a first-party API reference (e.g. the /reference/createtokenv3 endpoint page) and its own Postman collection plus a downloadable OpenAPI schema, so users can run example requests. However, that runnability lives in an external tool (Postman), and nothing shows the reference itself is interactive. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive "try it" console in the reference, embedded runnable code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
